description: Capabilities for the main AppLogsViewer window. The frontend talks to the Rust host exclusively over HTTP/WebSocket (axum on :8780, :8765, :8766) for data. The one exception is window-control IPC: `start_dragging` and `toggle_maximize` let the sidebar header and the top bar drag and maximise the native window when the title bar is overlay-hidden (macOS), and `set_theme` lets the Windows caption bar follow the app theme.
